in_english.long_meaning: The Arabic name Taahirah (طاهره) is derived from the root word طَهَرَ (ta-ha-ra), which means to purify, cleanse, or make something free from impurities. In Islamic tradition, the name Taahirah is associated with the concept of spiritual purity and innocence. It is a Quranic name, as mentioned in verse 33:35, where Allah describes the righteous women as 'taahiratun li-zurriyyatiha' (pure for their offspring). The name Taahirah conveys a sense of moral excellence, modesty, and humility, reflecting the qualities of a virtuous and pious Muslim woman. In Islamic culture, the name Taahirah is considered auspicious, as it is believed to bring blessings and protection to the bearer.
